answer: The design leans on escrowed payment for graded work, voided if the audit panel is not diverse, rewards vest against future work. Written in a short declarative sentences register, it stays short. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the forge of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. A lotus of per-task receipts records who did what, and the beacon of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce.
